headline: Google consolidates agentic AI capabilities under unified foundation structure
body: Google has moved its A2A (Agent-to-Agent) technology under a newly established Agentic AI Foundation, signaling a major organizational shift in how the company develops autonomous AI systems. This restructuring reflects Google's commitment to building AI agents capable of independent decision-making and task execution across enterprise environments. For healthcare AI, this matters because autonomous agents are increasingly relevant to clinical workflows, EHR automation, and care coordination tasks that currently rely on manual intervention. The consolidation suggests Google is positioning itself to deliver more integrated agent solutions to healthcare organizations, which could reshape how vendors approach workflow automation and administrative burden reduction in value-based care models.
